title: How Our Bodies Make Vitamin D | Corporis

cues.text: Vitamin D deficiency is a really common problem worldwide.
cues.en: Vitamin D deficiency is a really common problem worldwide.
cues.zh: 維生素 D 缺乏症是世界範圍內一個非常普遍的問題。

cues.en: the main way that we get Vitamin D is through sunlight.

cues.en: When UVB hits your skin, it stimulates a molecule in your skin called 7-dehydrocholesterol.

cues.zh: 得到了一種叫做膽鈣化醇的分子，它還沒有任何作用。

cues.en: but at a much smaller level.

cues.en: But we end up with a vitamin D hormone, which is what throws people off.

cues.en: Remember, a hormone is just a chemical that's secreted by a gland that travels through the bloodstream

cues.text: that have an effect somewhere else.

cues.en: it’s needed, which it’s actually really good at.
cues.zh: 它是必需的，而且它實際上非常擅長。

cues.text: And you’ve probably heard of one of its biggest uses in the body — calcium absorption.
cues.en: And you’ve probably heard of one of its biggest uses in the body — calcium absorption.
cues.zh: 您可能聽說過它在體內最大的用途之一—鈣吸收。

cues.text: Ever notice that milk always has vitamin D in it?
cues.en: Ever notice that milk always has vitamin D in it?
cues.zh: 有沒有註意到牛奶中總是含有維生素 D？

cues.text: That’s to help your body absorb calcium.
cues.en: That’s to help your body absorb calcium.
cues.zh: 這是為了幫助你的身體吸收鈣質。

cues.text: Here’s the thing though, Hormone D has receptors on most of the cells in your body.
cues.en: Here’s the thing though, Hormone D has receptors on most of the cells in your body.
cues.zh: 但事實是，荷爾蒙 D 在您體內的大多數細胞上都有受體。

cues.text: So it’s way more useful that just helping you with calcium absorption.
cues.en: So it’s way more useful that just helping you with calcium absorption.
cues.zh: 所以它比僅僅幫助你吸收鈣更有用。

cues.text: According to a 2010 article in the journal Diabetes, people with low amounts of Vitamin
cues.en: According to a 2010 article in the journal Diabetes, people with low amounts of Vitamin
cues.zh: 根據 2010 年《糖尿病》雜誌上的一篇文章，維生素含量低的人

cues.text: D had a 60% higher chance of heart disease than people with higher concentrations.
cues.en: D had a 60% higher chance of heart disease than people with higher concentrations.
cues.zh: D比濃度較高的人罹患心臟病的機率高出60%。

cues.text: Same goes for high blood pressure.
cues.en: Same goes for high blood pressure.
cues.zh: 高血壓也是如此。

cues.text: Lower Vitamin D is heavily correlated with increased blood pressure.
cues.en: Lower Vitamin D is heavily correlated with increased blood pressure.
cues.zh: 維生素 D 水平較低與血壓升高密切相關。

cues.text: Vitamin D also has a role in brain function and might help against depression.
cues.en: Vitamin D also has a role in brain function and might help against depression.
cues.zh: 維生素 D 對大腦功能也有一定作用，可能有助於對抗憂鬱症。

cues.text: One study in 2008 found that a year of Vitamin D supplementation significantly improved symptoms
cues.en: One study in 2008 found that a year of Vitamin D supplementation significantly improved symptoms
cues.zh: 2008 年的一項研究發現，補充維生素 D 一年可顯著改善症狀

cues.text: of depression.
cues.en: of depression.
cues.zh: 憂鬱症。

cues.text: This was in pill form, not sunlight, so any improved mood wasn’t from lifestyle changes.
cues.en: This was in pill form, not sunlight, so any improved mood wasn’t from lifestyle changes.
cues.zh: 這是藥丸形式，而不是陽光，因此任何情緒的改善都不是來自生活方式的改變。

cues.text: Point is, Vitamin D is so much more useful than just helping with calcium absorption.
cues.en: Point is, Vitamin D is so much more useful than just helping with calcium absorption.
cues.zh: 重點是，維生素 D 比僅僅幫助鈣吸收更有用。

cues.text: It can help make insulin, stimulate our immune system, it’s involved in gene regulation,
cues.en: It can help make insulin, stimulate our immune system, it’s involved in gene regulation,
cues.zh: 它可以幫助製造胰島素，刺激我們的免疫系統，它參與基因調節，

cues.text: and can even help in preventing certain cancers.
cues.en: and can even help in preventing certain cancers.
cues.zh: 甚至可以幫助預防某些癌症。

cues.text: Which is ironic considering the whole sunlight and skin cancer thing.
cues.en: Which is ironic considering the whole sunlight and skin cancer thing.
cues.zh: 考慮到整個陽光和皮膚癌的事情，這很諷刺。

cues.text: A couple things to keep in mind though.
cues.en: A couple things to keep in mind though.
cues.zh: 不過，有幾件事要記住。

cues.text: Like as you get older, your ability to crank out D3 from sunlight goes down.
cues.en: Like as you get older, your ability to crank out D3 from sunlight goes down.
cues.zh: 就像隨著年齡的增長，您從陽光中提取 D3 的能力會下降。

cues.text: So if you’re an older adult, you may need a bit more sun to get their vitamin D.
cues.en: So if you’re an older adult, you may need a bit more sun to get their vitamin D.
cues.zh: 因此，如果您是老年人，可能需要多曬曬太陽才能獲取維生素 D。

cues.text: Luckily, that’s not a problem in America.
cues.en: Luckily, that’s not a problem in America.
cues.zh: 幸運的是，這在美國不是問題。

cues.text: Looking at you Florida.
cues.en: Looking at you Florida.
cues.zh: 看著你佛羅裡達。

cues.text: Plus, if you have darker skin, you have more of a pigment called melanin.
cues.en: Plus, if you have darker skin, you have more of a pigment called melanin.
cues.zh: 另外，如果你的皮膚較黑，你會有更多一種叫做黑色素的色素。

cues.text: This pigment absorbs UVB, which is good news because your skin has a naturally higher sun
cues.en: This pigment absorbs UVB, which is good news because your skin has a naturally higher sun
cues.zh: 這種色素吸收 UVB，這是個好訊息，因為您的皮膚天然具有更高的陽光照射

cues.text: protection factor, but it also means you’re more likely to have vitamin D deficiency.
cues.en: protection factor, but it also means you’re more likely to have vitamin D deficiency.
cues.zh: 保護因素，但這也意味著您更有可能缺乏維生素 D。

cues.text: So folks with darker skin have to balance the D3 they get from diet along with sun exposure
cues.en: So folks with darker skin have to balance the D3 they get from diet along with sun exposure
cues.zh: 因此，膚色較深的人必須平衡從飲食中獲取的維生素 D3 和陽光照射

cues.text: making sure they’re not overdoing it on either.
cues.en: making sure they’re not overdoing it on either.
cues.zh: 確保他們在這兩個方面都沒有做得太過分。

cues.text: Exposure to sunlight is still our most efficient way of making Vitamin D, and that process
cues.en: Exposure to sunlight is still our most efficient way of making Vitamin D, and that process
cues.zh: 暴露在陽光下仍然是我們製造維生素 D 最有效的方法，而這個過程

cues.text: starts in our skin, which is something I wanted to underline.
cues.en: starts in our skin, which is something I wanted to underline.
cues.zh: 始於我們的皮膚，這是我想強調的一點。

cues.text: Because oftentimes we see our skin as just like, a protective layer.
cues.en: Because oftentimes we see our skin as just like, a protective layer.
cues.zh: 因為我們經常將皮膚視為保護層。

cues.text: When in reality it’s the largest organ in our body and it’s really active in homeostasis.
cues.en: When in reality it’s the largest organ in our body and it’s really active in homeostasis.
cues.zh: 事實上，它是我們體內最大的器官，而且它在體內平衡方面非常活躍。
